english_singular: A WordPress plugin that creates a Gutenberg block for contacting local representatives via templated letters sent through Resend.
Configure the letter template and API settings for the Find My Rep plugin.
The Find My Rep API endpoint used to look up representatives by postcode.
For local development with Docker, use http://host.docker.internal:3000/api/reps (the default).
For production, use the deployed API URL (e.g. https://find-my-rep.fly.dev/api/reps).
The address emails are sent from. Must be a verified domain in Resend. The constituent's address is used as Reply-To so replies go directly to them.
Enter your Resend API key for sending emails.
Enter the default letter template. Use {{representative_name}} and {{representative_title}} as placeholders.
Optional. When set, a copy of every letter sent via this plugin will be CC'd to this address for usage tracking. Leave empty to disable.
Select the email transport method. Use "Test" for development to log emails to file.
Please wait a few minutes before sending more messages.
